C1019.title: Fujitsu ProjectWEB Platform Suffers Unauthorized Access Leading to Data Breach
C1019.summary: In August 2021, Fujitsu issued an update on unauthorized access to its ProjectWEB project information sharing tool. The company said it had detected possible unauthorized access on May 6, 2021, and its investigation confirmed that portions of information for 129 customers in Japan had been viewed or downloaded, including system information, project management materials, and some personal information.
